1CH 7:1.KJV: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.
1CH 7:1.BHSA: וְלִבְנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֗ר תֹּולָ֧ע וּפוּאָ֛ה ישׁיב וְשִׁמְרֹ֖ון אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס

1CH 7:2.KJV: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
1CH 7:2.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י תֹולָ֗ע עֻזִּ֡י וּרְפָיָ֡ה וִֽ֠ירִיאֵל וְיַחְמַ֨י וְיִבְשָׂ֜ם וּשְׁמוּאֵ֗ל רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־אֲבֹותָם֙ לְתֹולָ֔ע גִּבֹּ֥ורֵי חַ֖יִל לְתֹלְדֹותָ֑ם מִסְפָּרָם֙ בִּימֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד עֶשְׂרִֽים־וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃ ס

1CH 7:3.KJV: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
1CH 7:3.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י עֻזִּ֖י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֗ה מִֽיכָאֵ֡ל וְ֠עֹבַדְיָה וְיֹואֵ֧ל יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה רָאשִׁ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

1CH 7:4.KJV: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
1CH 7:4.BHSA: וַעֲלֵיהֶ֨ם לְתֹלְדֹותָ֜ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹותָ֗ם גְּדוּדֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף כִּֽי־הִרְבּ֥וּ נָשִׁ֖ים וּבָנִֽים׃

1CH 7:5.KJV: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
1CH 7:5.BHSA: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם לְכֹל֙ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ות יִשָׂשכָ֔ר גִּבֹּורֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שְׁמֹונִ֤ים וְשִׁבְעָה֙ אֶ֔לֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂ֖ם לַכֹּֽל׃ פ

1CH 7:6.KJV: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

1CH 7:7.KJV: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
1CH 7:7.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗לַע אֶצְבֹּ֡ון וְעֻזִּ֡י וְ֠עֻזִּיאֵל וִירִימֹ֨ות וְעִירִ֜י חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אָבֹ֔ות גִּבֹּורֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֗ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס

1CH 7:8.KJV: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
1CH 7:8.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗כֶר זְמִירָ֡ה וְיֹועָ֡שׁ וֶ֠אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְאֶלְיֹועֵינַ֤י וְעָמְרִי֙ וִירֵמֹ֣ות וַאֲבִיָּ֔ה וַעֲנָתֹ֖ות וְעָלָ֑מֶת כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־בָֽכֶר׃

1CH 7:9.KJV: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
1CH 7:9.BHSA: וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לְתֹלְדֹותָ֗ם רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אֲבֹותָ֔ם גִּבֹּורֵ֖י חָ֑יִל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ ס

1CH 7:10.KJV: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
1CH 7:10.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י יְדִיעֲאֵ֖ל בִּלְהָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֗ן יעישׁ וּ֠בִנְיָמִן וְאֵה֤וּד וּֽכְנַעֲנָה֙ וְזֵיתָ֔ן וְתַרְשִׁ֖ישׁ וַאֲחִישָֽׁחַר׃

1CH 7:11.KJV: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
1CH 7:11.BHSA: כָּל־אֵ֜לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ לְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָבֹ֔ות גִּבֹּורֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שִׁבְעָֽה־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּמָאתַ֔יִם יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֖א לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

1CH 7:12.KJV: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
1CH 7:12.BHSA: וְשֻׁפִּ֤ם וְחֻפִּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י עִ֔יר חֻשִׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אַחֵֽר׃

1CH 7:13.KJV: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
1CH 7:13.BHSA: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֗י יַחֲצִיאֵ֧ל וְגוּנִ֛י וְיֵ֥צֶר וְשַׁלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֥י בִלְהָֽה׃ פ

1CH 7:14.KJV: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
1CH 7:14.BHSA: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אַשְׂרִיאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלָ֑דָה פִּֽילַגְשֹׁו֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּיָּ֔ה יָלְדָ֕ה אֶת־מָכִ֖יר אֲבִ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃

1CH 7:15.KJV: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
1CH 7:15.BHSA: וּמָכִ֞יר לָקַ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לְחֻפִּ֣ים וּלְשֻׁפִּ֔ים וְשֵׁ֤ם אֲחֹתֹו֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י צְלָפְחָ֑ד וַתִּהְיֶ֥נָה לִצְלָפְחָ֖ד בָּנֹֽות׃

1CH 7:16.KJV: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
1CH 7:16.BHSA: וַתֵּ֨לֶד מַעֲכָ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת־מָכִיר֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמֹו֙ פֶּ֔רֶשׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו שָׁ֑רֶשׁ וּבָנָ֖יו אוּלָ֥ם וָרָֽקֶם׃

1CH 7:17.KJV: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
1CH 7:17.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י אוּלָ֖ם בְּדָ֑ן אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד בֶּן־מָכִ֖יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

1CH 7:18.KJV: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
1CH 7:18.BHSA: וַאֲחֹתֹ֖ו הַמֹּלֶ֑כֶת יָלְדָה֙ אֶת־אִישְׁהֹ֔וד וְאֶת־אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר וְאֶת־מַחְלָֽה׃

1CH 7:19.KJV: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
1CH 7:19.BHSA: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אַחְיָ֣ן וָשֶׁ֔כֶם וְלִקְחִ֖י וַאֲנִיעָֽם׃ פ

1CH 7:20.KJV: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
1CH 7:20.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם שׁוּתָ֑לַח וּבֶ֤רֶד בְּנֹו֙ וְתַ֣חַת בְּנֹ֔ו וְאֶלְעָדָ֥ה בְנֹ֖ו וְתַ֥חַת בְּנֹֽו׃

1CH 7:21.KJV: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
1CH 7:21.BHSA: וְזָבָ֥ד בְּנֹ֛ו וְשׁוּתֶ֥לַח בְּנֹ֖ו וְעֵ֣זֶר וְאֶלְעָ֑ד וַהֲרָג֗וּם אַנְשֵׁי־גַת֙ הַנֹּולָדִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י יָרְד֔וּ לָקַ֖חַת אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃

1CH 7:22.KJV: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
1CH 7:22.BHSA: וַיִּתְאַבֵּ֛ל אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֲבִיהֶ֖ם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶחָ֖יו לְנַחֲמֹֽו׃

1CH 7:23.KJV: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
1CH 7:23.BHSA: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־אִשְׁתֹּ֔ו וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמֹו֙ בְּרִיעָ֔ה כִּ֥י בְרָעָ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בְּבֵיתֹֽו׃

1CH 7:24.KJV: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
1CH 7:24.BHSA: וּבִתֹּ֣ו שֶׁאֱרָ֔ה וַתִּ֧בֶן אֶת־בֵּית־חֹורֹ֛ון הַתַּחְתֹּ֖ון וְאֶת־הָעֶלְיֹ֑ון וְאֵ֖ת אֻזֵּ֥ן שֶׁאֱרָֽה׃

1CH 7:25.KJV: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son.
1CH 7:25.BHSA: וְרֶ֣פַח בְּנֹ֗ו וְרֶ֧שֶׁף וְתֶ֛לַח בְּנֹ֖ו וְתַ֥חַן בְּנֹֽו׃

1CH 7:26.KJV: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son.
1CH 7:26.BHSA: לַעְדָּ֥ן בְּנֹ֛ו עַמִּיה֥וּד בְּנֹ֖ו אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע בְּנֹֽו׃

1CH 7:27.KJV: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.

1CH 7:28.KJV: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
1CH 7:28.BHSA: וַאֲחֻזָּתָם֙ וּמֹ֣שְׁבֹותָ֔ם בֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וְלַמִּזְרָ֣ח נַעֲרָ֔ן וְלַֽמַּעֲרָ֗ב גֶּ֤זֶר וּבְנֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ וּשְׁכֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ עַד־עַיָּ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

1CH 7:29.KJV: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
1CH 7:29.BHSA: וְעַל־יְדֵ֣י בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בֵּית־שְׁאָ֤ן וּבְנֹתֶ֨יהָ֙ תַּעְנַ֣ךְ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ מְגִדֹּ֥ו וּבְנֹותֶ֖יהָ דֹּ֣ור וּבְנֹותֶ֑יהָ בְּאֵ֨לֶּה֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י יֹוסֵ֖ף בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ פ

1CH 7:30.KJV: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
1CH 7:30.BHSA: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֥רַח אֲחֹותָֽם׃

1CH 7:31.KJV: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
1CH 7:31.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י ברזות׃

1CH 7:32.KJV: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
1CH 7:32.BHSA: וְחֶ֨בֶר֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־יַפְלֵ֔ט וְאֶת־שֹׁומֵ֖ר וְאֶת־חֹותָ֑ם וְאֵ֖ת שׁוּעָ֥א אֲחֹותָֽם׃

1CH 7:33.KJV: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
1CH 7:33.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י יַפְלֵ֔ט פָּסַ֥ךְ וּבִמְהָ֖ל וְעַשְׁוָ֑ת אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יַפְלֵֽט׃

1CH 7:34.KJV: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
1CH 7:34.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֖י שָׁ֑מֶר אֲחִ֥י ורוהגה יחבה וַאֲרָֽם׃

1CH 7:35.KJV: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
1CH 7:35.BHSA: וּבֶן־הֵ֖לֶם אָחִ֑יו צֹופַ֥ח וְיִמְנָ֖ע וְשֵׁ֥לֶשׁ וְעָמָֽל׃

1CH 7:36.KJV: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
1CH 7:36.BHSA: בְּנֵ֖י צֹופָ֑ח ס֧וּחַ וְחַרְנֶ֛פֶר וְשׁוּעָ֖ל וּבֵרִ֥י וְיִמְרָֽה׃

1CH 7:37.KJV: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
1CH 7:37.BHSA: בֶּ֣צֶר וָהֹ֗וד וְשַׁמָּ֧א וְשִׁלְשָׁ֛ה וְיִתְרָ֖ן וּבְאֵרָֽא׃

1CH 7:38.KJV: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

1CH 7:39.KJV: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

1CH 7:40.KJV: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
1CH 7:40.BHSA: כָּל־אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־אָ֠שֵׁר רָאשֵׁ֨י בֵית־הָאָבֹ֤ות בְּרוּרִים֙ גִּבֹּורֵ֣י חֲיָלִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֤ם בַּצָּבָא֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִסְפָּרָ֣ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ ס

records.name: Asher
records.distinguisher: eighth-born son of Jacob (GEN 30:11, GEN 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid

records.name: Benjamin
records.distinguisher: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (GEN 35:18)

records.name: Bilhah
records.distinguisher: maid of Laban given to Rachel (GEN 29:29) and wife of Jacob (GEN 30:4)

records.name: David
records.distinguisher: son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3)

records.name: Elishama
records.distinguisher: head of the tribe of Ephraim during the census (NUM 1:10)

records.name: Gilead
records.distinguisher: a son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh (NUM 26:29)

records.name: Hammolecheth
records.distinguisher: sister of Gilead and daughter of Machir (1CH 7:18)

records.name: Iezer
records.distinguisher: named among the sons of Gilead (NUM 26:30) and called Abiezer in JOS 17:2; whether he is the Abiezer whom Gilead's sister Hammolecheth bore (1CH 7:18) the text does not settle

records.name: Issachar
records.distinguisher: ninth-born son of Jacob (GEN 30:17), son of Leah
